statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail 12% (low), Stress 37% (moderate), Confidence 87% (high). Shared assessment for NQ futures and NAS100 CFD.
recommendation: Tail remains well below the block threshold, so the mapped state is EA_ON. Conditional risk is concentrated in a narrow 13:30-15:00 UTC band covering the U.S. cash open, the Richmond Fed survey and the Williams and Jefferson remarks; that band is published as the danger window instead of the whole session. Existing-position management and emergency protection logic are unaffected by this mapping. This is a descriptive market-regime assessment, not personal financial advice.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures recover an overnight dip in full; orderly two-way trade keeps tail risk low ahead of the U.S. open and the Fed-speaker block
body: Monday closed with the Nasdaq-100 cash index at a record 30,482.35, up 2.83% on the session, as an AI and semiconductor rally lifted the Nasdaq Composite 2.26% to a record 27,122.09, the S&P 500 1.49% to 7,764.70 and the Dow 0.71% to 52,048.83. Leadership was extreme at the single-name level, with Arm up about 17%, Intel 12.2%, Meta above 11% on the reception of its Muse agent and AMD near 10% as it crossed a $1 trillion market value; the PHLX semiconductor index gained 4.3%. Overnight, NQ Dec-26 futures dipped to 30,670.00 and have recovered the entire give-back, trading at 30,781.50, unchanged at -0.01%, inside a 30,670.00-30,916.50 range. That dip-and-full-recovery is direct evidence that retracement is functioning, which is why Tail eases to 12 from 13 an hour earlier. VIX at 14.89 shows no volatility bid, and crude has fallen for a fifth consecutive session to a two-week low, with WTI near 91.13-91.28 and Brent at 99.54, on reporting that Iran could reopen the Strait of Hormuz if the U.S. lifted its blockade of Iranian ports. The unresolved tension in the backdrop is rates: the 10-year yield is near 4.96% after easing below 5% on Monday, the 2-year stands at 4.76% against an effective funds rate of 3.88%, and St. Louis Fed President Musalem has argued publicly that further rate increases are likely needed. Record equity levels alongside a live hiking debate justify Stress in the moderate band at 37 even while Tail stays low. The day's catalyst density sits in one narrow block: the 13:30 UTC cash open, the Richmond Fed survey at 14:00, Fed Williams at 14:05 and Vice Chair Jefferson at 14:20 at a Treasury Market Conference, followed by the 2-year note auction and Fed Barkin at 17:00. Conditional Tail therefore peaks at 25 in the 14:00-15:00 UTC hour and returns to the low band after the U.S. close. No persistent one-way structure, shallow-pullback sequence or failed-retracement extension is currently observed in the NQ price path.

lookbackSummary: The previous 24 hours cover Monday's record U.S. session and the calm overnight that followed. Published Tail began the window at 14 in the European morning, rose through 20-22 into the cash open and peaked at 33 with Stress at 57 in the 19:00 UTC power hour as the AI and chip advance extended into the close, holding the orange BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES mapping from 14:00 to 19:00 UTC. Tail then dropped to 23 at the close, 14 an hour later and settled at 11-13 through the Asian and European overnight, with the dominant mode reverting from trend-up to normal at 22:00 UTC. Stress followed the same arc from 57 down to 31-39, and Confidence stayed in the high band at 84-90 throughout. The last eight hours show an orderly two-way overnight range rather than continuation of Monday's trend.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours contain one dense U.S. catalyst block and an otherwise quiet profile. Conditional Tail holds 12-15 through the European morning and the 12:00 UTC pre-open hour, steps to 22 for the hour containing the 13:30 UTC cash open, and peaks at 25 in the 14:00-15:00 UTC hour where the Richmond Fed survey, Fed Williams and Vice Chair Jefferson coincide inside the first post-open hour. It then holds 22-24 across the afternoon, including the 17:00 UTC 2-year auction and Fed Barkin remarks and the 19:00 UTC power hour, before returning to the EA_ON mapping at 18 for the 20:00 UTC cash close and to 12-14 overnight. The final hours drift back to 13-15 as Wednesday's flash PMI block approaches. Only the current hour states observed price-path structure; every later slot is conditional, and Confidence decays from 87 to 77 with forecast distance.
